question: Grupo Industrial Batellero avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Grupo Industrial Batellero S.A. de C.V.
is an independent, 100% Mexican-owned private company founded in 2013, with its general director and key executive being Lorena Patricia Ortiz Arteaga. It operates as its own parent entity rather than a subsidiary of a larger multinational conglomerate, producing gourmet foods and personal care lines under the brands
Avogratto
(food/avocado oils) and
Avoskin
(cosmetics)
